name: Edens Hawaii – Hawaiian Clothing Manufacturer
old_description: My husband has worn aloha shirts exclusively in warm weather since 1970. The shirts need to be only two colors, all cotton, with a pocket, and made in Hawaii. This beautiful shirt has become his new favorite. It arrived very quickly, and emotes the spirit of aloha. Thank you Edens Hawaii.
about:
Edens Hawaii operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, producing tropical apparel that includes muumuu dresses, aloha shirts, and matching family and couples outfits. The company does not state a founding year, founder names, or ownership structure in the provided materials.

The brand manufactures its garments in Hawaii, describing them as "handmade in Hawaii" and "made in Hawaii." Product listings show items constructed from cotton and rayon fabrics, with styles ranging from traditional hibiscus prints to wedding dresses and coordinated family sets. No facility size, headcount, production volumes, or specific manufacturing processes are disclosed.

Edens Hawaii sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce website. The input does not identify any wholesale, uniform, or B2B customer segments, nor does it name specific industries served beyond retail apparel.

The company does not articulate a founding mission or stated differentiator beyond the "made in Hawaii" provenance of its garments.
